requirements.heading: Format of a Delivery Status Notification
requirements.text: The DSN MUST be addressed (in both the message header and the transport envelope) to the return address from the transport envelope which accompanied the original message for which the DSN was generated.

requirements.heading: Format of a Delivery Status Notification
requirements.text: The From field of the message header of the DSN SHOULD contain the address of a human who is responsible for maintaining the mail system at the Reporting MTA site (e.g., Postmaster), so that a reply to the DSN will reach that person.

requirements.heading: Format of a Delivery Status Notification
requirements.text: Exception: if a DSN is translated from a foreign delivery report, and the gateway performing the translation cannot determine the appropriate address, the From field of the DSN MAY be the address of a human who is responsible for maintaining the gateway.

requirements.heading: Format of a Delivery Status Notification
requirements.text: The envelope sender address of the DSN SHOULD be chosen to ensure that no delivery status reports will be issued in response to the DSN itself, and MUST be chosen so that DSNs will not generate mail loops.

requirements.heading: Format of a Delivery Status Notification
requirements.text: Whenever an SMTP transaction is used to send a DSN, the MAIL FROM command MUST use a NULL return address, i.e., "MAIL FROM:<>".

requirements.heading: Format of a Delivery Status Notification
requirements.text: However, an MTA MAY report on the delivery status for several recipients of the same message in a single DSN.

requirements.heading: The message/delivery-status content-type
requirements.text: MIME type name: message MIME subtype name: delivery-status Optional parameters: none Encoding considerations: "7bit" encoding is sufficient and MUST be used to maintain readability when viewed by non-MIME mail readers.

requirements.heading: The Original-Envelope-Id field
requirements.text: If such an envelope identifier was present in the envelope that accompanied the message when it arrived at the Reporting MTA, it SHOULD be supplied in the Original-Envelope-Id field of any DSNs issued as a result of an attempt to deliver the message.

requirements.heading: The Original-Envelope-Id field
requirements.text: Except when a DSN is issued by the sender's MTA, an MTA MUST NOT supply this field unless there is an envelope-identifier field in the envelope that accompanied this message on its arrival at the Reporting MTA.

requirements.heading: The Original-Envelope-Id field
requirements.text: The DSN MUST preserve the original case and spelling of the envelope-id.

requirements.heading: The Reporting-MTA DSN field
requirements.text: If an MTA functions as a gateway between dissimilar mail environments and thus is known by multiple names depending on the environment, the mta-name sub-field SHOULD contain the name used by the environment from which the message was accepted by the Reporting-MTA.

requirements.heading: The DSN-Gateway field
requirements.text: This field MUST appear in any DSN that was translated by a gateway from a foreign system into DSN format, and MUST NOT appear otherwise.

requirements.heading: The Received-From-MTA DSN field
requirements.text: If the message was received from an Internet host via SMTP, the contents of the mta-name sub-field SHOULD be the Internet domain name supplied in the HELO or EHLO command, and the network address used by the SMTP client SHOULD be included as a comment enclosed in parentheses.

requirements.heading: The Received-From-MTA DSN field
requirements.text: Since case is significant in some mail systems, the exact spelling, including case, of the MTA name SHOULD be preserved.

requirements.heading: The Arrival-Date DSN field
requirements.text: Numeric timezones ([+/-]HHMM format) MUST be used.

requirements.heading: Final-Recipient field
requirements.text: This field MUST be present in each set of per-recipient data.

requirements.heading: Final-Recipient field
requirements.text: The generic-address sub-field of the Final-Recipient field MUST contain the mailbox address of the recipient (from the transport envelope), as it was when the Reporting MTA accepted the message for delivery.

requirements.heading: Final-Recipient field
requirements.text: Instead, it MUST report exactly the address received in the envelope, unless that address contains characters such as CR or LF which are not allowed in a DSN field.

requirements.heading: Final-Recipient field
requirements.text: Since mailbox addresses (including those used in the Internet) may be case sensitive, the case of alphabetic characters in the address MUST be preserved.

requirements.heading: Action field
requirements.text: This field MUST be present for each recipient named in the DSN.

requirements.heading: Action field
requirements.text: This action-value SHOULD NOT be used unless the sender has requested notification of successful delivery for this recipient.

requirements.heading: Action field
requirements.text: An action-value of "expanded" SHOULD NOT be used with a DSN issued on delivery of a message to a "mailing list".

requirements.heading: Status field
requirements.text: This field MUST be present for each delivery attempt which is described by a DSN.

requirements.heading: Status field
requirements.text: ; White-space characters and comments are NOT allowed within ; a status-code, though a comment enclosed in parentheses ; MAY follow the last numeric sub-field of the status-code.

requirements.heading: Status field
requirements.text: ; Each numeric sub-field within the status-code MUST be ; expressed without leading zero digits.

requirements.heading: Remote-MTA field
requirements.text: It MUST NOT be included if no remote MTA was involved in the attempted delivery of the message to that recipient.

requirements.heading: Diagnostic-Code field
requirements.text: In addition to the Diagnostic-Code itself, additional textual description of the diagnostic, MAY appear in a comment enclosed in parentheses.

requirements.heading: Diagnostic-Code field
requirements.text: However, this field SHOULD be included if transport-specific diagnostic information is available.

requirements.heading: Last-Attempt-Date field
requirements.text: It MUST NOT be included if the actual date and time of the last delivery attempt are not available (which might be the case if the DSN were being issued by a gateway).

requirements.heading: Will-Retry-Until field
requirements.text: The Will-Retry-Until field is optional for "delay" DSNs, and MUST NOT appear in other DSNs.

requirements.heading: Extension fields
requirements.text: DSN field names NOT beginning with "X-" MUST be registered with the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) and published in an RFC.

requirements.heading: Conformance and Usage Requirements
requirements.text: MTAs and gateways MUST NOT generate the Original-Recipient field of a DSN unless the mail transfer protocol provides the address originally specified by the sender at the time of submission.

requirements.heading: Conformance and Usage Requirements
requirements.text: Each sender-specified recipient address SHOULD result in at most one "delivered" or "failed" DSN for that recipient.

requirements.heading: Conformance and Usage Requirements
requirements.text: If a positive DSN is requested (e.g., one using NOTIFY=SUCCESS in SMTP) for a recipient that is forwarded to multiple recipients of an "alias" (as defined in [DRPT], section 7.2.7), the forwarding MTA SHOULD normally issue a "expanded" DSN for the originally-specified recipient and not propagate the request for a DSN to the forwarding addresses.

requirements.heading: Conformance and Usage Requirements
requirements.text: Alternatively, the forwarding MTA MAY relay the request for a DSN to exactly one of the forwarding addresses and not propagate the request to the others.

requirements.heading: Conformance and Usage Requirements
requirements.text: Upon delivery of a message to a recipient address corresponding to a mailing list exploder, the Reporting MTA SHOULD issue an appropriate DSN exactly as if the recipient address were that of an ordinary mailbox.

requirements.heading: Acknowledgments
requirements.text: ; White-space characters and comments are NOT allowed within a ; a status-code, though a comment enclosed in parentheses ; MAY follow the last numeric sub-field of the status-code.

requirements.heading: Acknowledgments
requirements.text: For DSNs produced from foreign delivery or nondelivery notifications, the name of the gateway MUST appear in the DSN-Gateway field of the DSN.

requirements.heading: Acknowledgments
requirements.text: IANA MAY reject DSN type registrations because of incomplete registration forms, imprecise specifications, or inappropriate type names.
